lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into a matrix of approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Spot size increases and spacing widens moving from the anterior to the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clear vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (stripes) intersect with horizontal rows of blobs. The blobs are positioned as anchor nodes at the intersection points, creating a rigid grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side, running parallel to the spine.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12 to 15 discrete high-luminance blobs are distributed across the first dorsal fin. The density is highest along the base and the posterior margin, with a relative absence of spots at the distal apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, irregular indentation or notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. Several orange-hued particulates are present on the caudal peduncle, though these may be water-column backscatter rather than dermal features.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a distinct transition to a much higher spatial density of micro-blobs with significantly smaller pixel diameters compared to the patterns on the lateral flank.
